archetypes.name: hook-streams
archetypes.rationale: Hook contract streams changed while retiring lib-quiet.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the hook changes for deny-edit-write, sessionstart-health, and hook-stop-fail-close. Focus on stdout versus FD 3 behavior, jq-missing static fallbacks, stripped PATH behavior, and exit-0 fail-open or block semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: residual-scope
archetypes.rationale: Linter and CI shell scopes now depend on a new residual manifest.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the residual Bash manifest and its Python reader together with lint-bash32, lint-awk-multibyte-regex, lint-renderer-substitution-safety, pre-commit wrappers, and CI shellcheck. Focus on --root fixture behavior, standalone awk coverage, and accidental coverage loss. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retirement-cleanup
archetypes.rationale: Terminal libraries and harnesses were deleted with docs and migrated-script records.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the deleted Bash libraries, includes, harness removals, and migrated-scripts rows. Check for surviving runtime callers, stale docs, or Makefile/checks references that would make the retirement incomplete. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
